title: Discover
desc: We dig into your domain, constraints and edge cases before a line of code is written. You get a scoped plan with honest trade-offs — not a sales pitch.

title: Architect
desc: System design, data models, tenancy and security decisions are documented and challenged early — while changing them is still cheap.

title: Design
desc: Flows and interfaces designed as systems: tokens, components and motion that scale with the product instead of fighting it.

title: Build
desc: Short, shippable iterations with a demo every week. Code review, tests and CI/CD are defaults here — not premium add-ons.

title: Harden
desc: Load testing, security review, compliance checks and observability — before launch, not after the first incident.

title: Scale
desc: We stay on for monitoring, iteration and roadmap execution as real usage grows — the launch is the start, not the finish.
